name: The Gallery At Westbury Plaza
summary: The Gallery at Westbury Plaza is a well-regarded shopping center on Long Island featuring department stores, apparel brands, home goods retailers, and diverse dining options including a wine bar. With nearly 4,800 reviews and a 4.4-star rating, it serves as a popular retail destination for Nassau County's North Shore communities.
demographics: The Gallery at Westbury Plaza attracts a diverse, affluent suburban demographic from Nassau County's North Shore, with visitors primarily consisting of middle to upper-middle income families and professionals aged 30-65. The trade area encompasses the well-established communities of Garden City, Westbury, and surrounding Long Island towns, known for their high household incomes and educated populations. Shoppers tend to be quality-conscious consumers seeking a convenient mix of department stores, specialty retailers, and dining options for both everyday needs and special purchases. The center draws both local residents for regular shopping trips and regional visitors attracted by its anchor stores and dining venues including the wine bar.
description: The Gallery at Westbury Plaza is a prominent shopping destination located on Old Country Road in Garden City, New York, serving the affluent North Shore communities of Long Island. This well-established shopping center offers visitors a comprehensive retail experience featuring department store anchors, popular apparel brands, and an array of home goods retailers all in one convenient location. Beyond traditional shopping, the center has evolved to meet modern consumer preferences by incorporating diverse dining options, including a distinctive wine bar that adds an upscale touch to the shopping experience. With operating hours from 10 AM to 10 PM daily, the plaza accommodates both daytime shoppers and evening diners, making it a versatile destination for Nassau County residents. The center's strong reputation is reflected in its impressive 4.4-star rating from nearly 4,800 reviews, demonstrating consistent customer satisfaction and its position as a trusted retail hub in the Garden City area.
